title: A singular integral two-by-two matrix has a primitive kernel vector
statement: For every matrix M∈Mat₂(ℤ) with det M=0, there exist integers p,q such that IsCoprime p q and M(p,q)ᵀ=0. Here IsCoprime p q means that some integers α,β satisfy αp+βq=1; in particular, the vector is nonzero. The statement includes M=0.
lean_statement: ∀ M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ, M.det = 0 → ∃ p q : ℤ, IsCoprime p q ∧ M.mulVec ![p, q] = 0
